Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You cite market increases to support your price, yet your earlier letter says your alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices; it seems the key distinction is between market movements and costs actually reaching you. We want a transparent price basis that supports our continuing partnership and reflects your actual cost exposure. Building on your owner's offer to review the calculation, how can you substantiate the material, labour and processing elements in a cost-breakdown XLSX that accounts for that fixed-price cover?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Using your own cost shares (AS-14404 45%, LCI-C 5%, PPI-C2431 38%) and the latest six-month index moves (AS-14404 -0.3% (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09), LCI-C +1.7% (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06), PPI-C2431 +9.7% (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08)), your cost increase comes to about +3.6% of the price, not +11.0%. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.73 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.70 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. While we cannot provide internal cost breakdowns, please note that our AS-14404 requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning recent market decreases do not reduce our costs. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

Because of the extended 24-month duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material price risks. We welcome your commitment to a 24-month contract and the 14-day payment terms, which allow us to offer a revised price of €5.49 per unit.

Our current offer is a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.49 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You repeatedly stress your fixed-price cover while requiring an index clause; it seems the exposure after that cover expires is your central concern. We want a competitive base price that distinguishes costs already secured from future material risk. How can we use contract certainty to reach a lower fixed price without paying for risk your existing cover already removes?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.84 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You repeatedly emphasise material-risk allocation, while your earlier letter says your alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices; it seems the key is distinguishing current costs from future exposure. We want a price grounded in your actual cost base, with any future risk transfer recognised rather than charged twice. How can you share the calculation workbook your owner offered, separating material, financing and conversion costs so we can verify that basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.99 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
